quote.translation: The true contingency that sets the player's heart pounding lies, rather, in the force of the first push itself: in the fact that the determinate strength given as fact does not necessarily possess absolute necessity, that we think it could also have been some other strength, that is, in the fact that no contradiction whatever arises if we think of it as some other strength.
